content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

A sovereign digital commerce stack is more than just a workaround; it's a fundamental shift in how digital products are sold and delivered. By leveraging open-source tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, creators can build a fully operational online store that's free from the shackles of foreign payment processors. The result is a more secure, more scalable, and more profitable digital commerce architecture that's tailored to the needs of creators in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is deceptively simple. By using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle backend logic, creators can automate delivery of their digital products, including ebooks, templates, and fonts. Meanwhile, NOWPayments takes care of automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, eliminating the need for costly payment processors like Stripe and Gumroad. The result is a seamless and secure buying experience for customers, with creators retaining up to 99.5% of their sales revenue.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
The sovereign digital commerce stack is the ultimate solution for digital creators looking to say goodbye to costly payment processors like Stripe and Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of the sovereign digital commerce stack include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. By combining these open-source tools, creators can build a fully operational online store that's tailored to their specific needs and budget.
